answer.rationale: The 18% cost mandate and 14-day renewal window create urgency, but the 94% capacity utilization leaves no room for supply disruption. Negotiating with the incumbent (per memory_c4's proven recovery of margin through benchmarking) offers the fastest path to cost reduction without onboarding risk. memory_c2 shows switching is operationally viable, but triggers onboarding latency we cannot absorb. memory_c6 indicates multi-year commitments unlock volume pricing. A negotiated renewal combining aggressive benchmarking against market rates (c4 precedent) with a longer commitment window to access volume discounts (c6 precedent) can plausibly meet the 18% target while preserving supply continuity. If negotiation yields <12% savings, defer to Q2 when capacity buffer exists. This preserves optionality for a second source add or vendor switch in a lower-risk window.
